description: This PHP file defines the class ConfiguratorViewSugarpdfsettings, which extends SugarView. It handles the display, saving, and restoring of PDF configuration settings within the SuiteCRM administration module, including managing logo uploads and PDF class selection.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewSugarpdfsettings
classes.description: A class managing the UI and configuration logic for SugarCRM's PDF settings in the admin panel.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an admin before allowing access to the page.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module's title display, including links.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the PDF settings page, handle form submissions for saving or restoring settings, manage logo uploads, and prepare data for the template.

methods.name: checkUploadImage
methods.description: Handles validation and movement of uploaded logo images, checking for errors and verifying image integrity.
